title: SP Hub v1o2
features:
SP Hub Legends of Speed v1.2 Script

Chnges for the new uptade v1.2

Features:
(Info)
Added language support
(Arabic, English, Russian, Turkish, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese)

(Main)
Added Orb Type (Red, Yellow, Blue, Orange, All)
Added Auto Pull Orbs & Gems
Added Orb Amount & Collect Orbs by Amount
Added Gems Amount & Collect Gems by Amount
Added Auto Win Race
Added Auto Join Race
Added Auto Hoops
Added Hide Hoops

(Shop)
Added Buy Amount for Crystals
Added Teleport to Crystal
Added Crystal ESP

(Teleports)
Added new teleport locations
(Grass Course – lvl 5, Frost Course – lvl 15, Parkour Challenge – lvl 35, Pirate Course – lvl 50)

Improvements:
Switched UI from SP Lib v1 to SP Lib v2
Fully improved the collecting system
Improved crystal purchasing (changed from Buttons to Dropdown)
Overall script optimization and improvements

Removed:
Nothing removed

Bug Fixes:
Fixed location detection bug
Fixed several known issues
